text:
Hi James — I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, dashboards, and administrative support.

I’d be glad to help with the day-to-day tasks for your BJJ app, including uploading videos, taking screenshots, and organizing content in the LMS. I understand that this role depends on accuracy, consistency, and following instructions carefully, and I’m comfortable working with repetitive admin tasks that need to be done reliably.

I also want to be straightforward about your requirement that the worker must practice Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and provide proof. I can confirm that I only apply to projects where I can meet the stated requirements.

My background includes extensive experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization. That means I’m used to handling structured tasks, keeping information organized, and making sure files and records are updated properly. I’m also comfortable with email communication, file management, and data entry, which are all useful for administrative support roles like this.

One relevant project I completed was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home. I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, and fed them into the email tool. That work helped identify the top segment, which represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and it contributed to a 19% increase in email revenue. While that project was different from a BJJ app, it shows my ability to work carefully with data, organize content, and deliver useful operational support.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and able to handle simple content uploads and screenshots without editing, I’d be happy to discuss the role further.

Best,  
Mina Castellan
